integrity: Exact first-passage derivations and executable rational consistency checks are provided. Asymptotic proofs are analytic, not inferred from finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Only complete rooted regular trees, known root, uniform independent with-replacement offers and fixed branching/offers in the height limit; not a general-graph cover-time theorem. Full historical priority is not independently established.
title: A sharp choice threshold and contrasting root-hitting laws on regular trees
